summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Questing Academy v0.7 RPG features: walking hero on RealmMap + TownHub, NPC Talk dialogues, Quest engine v2 with battle banner + Adventure Hub daily mission, realm-specific battle background, dynamic TopBar title. 20/21 assertions passed on desktop (1440x900). The single 'fail' was a test-methodology issue (AnimatePresence retains the dialogue node in DOM during exit transition so count()==0 returned false), not an actual product defect — the screenshot taken at that moment confirms the dialogue was visually closed and the town UI was fully interactive.

issues: Hero chibi spawns at the bottom-center default (x:50,y:88), which on first load can briefly overlap the bottom-most building tile (Boss Gate at 50%/78%) before the user clicks elsewhere. Cosmetic only.

action_items: (Optional) For more deterministic test automation of quest completion mid-battle, consider exposing window.__gameStore in development builds so Playwright can call tickQuestOnCorrect() directly instead of relying on random math questions.
critical_code_review_comments: gameStore.tickQuestOnCorrect correctly awards XP + coins with proper level-up cascade and clears questRun atomically — implementation is sound.
Battle.tsx: realm-specific bg lookup is memoized correctly; falls back to DEFAULT_BG when no approved bg exists. Good defensive coding.
TownHub.tsx: useEffect setActiveRealm(realmId) keeps active realm in sync even on deep-link entry into the town — good.
NpcDialogue.tsx: uses AnimatePresence with framer-motion exit animations; works as designed but means data-testid stays in DOM briefly. Not a defect.
RealmMap.tsx: handleIslandClick stopPropagation correctly prevents the canvas-click walk from firing in parallel with island navigation.

QuestsPreview.tsx: parseTarget regex correctly extracts target=3 from 'Answer 3 grade-K questions'; parseRewards extracts xp=20, coins=10 from '20 XP, 10 coins, First Friend sticker' — verified by inspection of seed.

Disabled Start buttons are correctly disabled while another quest is in progress (disabled prop + disabled: classes), but note: disabled HTML attribute removes pointer events so clicks are no-op as expected.
Minor: Battle quest-complete-toast auto-dismisses after 4500ms via setTimeout; if user navigates away during that window the timer is not cleared (no memory leak risk, but minor cleanup opportunity).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (20/21 — the 1 fail is test-script methodology, not a product bug)

test_credentials: Onboarding used name='Tester', Grade=Kindergarten (default), Companion=Spriggle. Admin PIN 2580 not exercised in this iteration.
verified_features: Onboarding -> /adventure transition works (all gating: landing-play-btn, onboarding-next-btn, avatar-name-input, character-continue-btn, starter-card-spriggle, starter-confirm-btn).
RealmMap: hero-sprite renders, canvas click moves hero (dx=-341,dy=-367 measured) within ~900ms.
RealmMap: realm-node-realm-1 click walks hero then navigates to /adventure/town/realm-1.
TownHub: town-canvas + town-hero-sprite render; all 4 tiles (hatchery, learning-academy, town-hub, quest-board) present.

TownHub Talk icons: hatchery + learning-academy show 💬 (Linden + Bramble NPCs). quest-board, shop, town-hub correctly do NOT show Talk icon (no approved quest-giver/shopkeeper/guide NPC for realm-1 — Mochi is status='pending').
NpcDialogue: modal opens with name 'Linden the Keeper', dialogue line, Speak/Continue/Bye buttons all present. Both Continue and Bye visually close the modal (AnimatePresence exit anim).
Tile nav: town-tile-hatchery walks hero then navigates to /egg.
Quests: quest-card-q-1 + quest-start-q-1 present; clicking start sets questRun in localStorage AND navigates to /battle.
Battle: battle-quest-banner with battle-quest-progress and battle-quest-abandon all render when questRun is active.
Battle TopBar shows 'Adventure: Meadowfall Grove' (not 'Meadowfall Path') when activeRealmId=realm-1.
questRun persists to localStorage under key 'questing-academy-state-v1' with shape { questId, questTitle, target:3, progress, rewardXp:20, rewardCoins:10, rewardLabel, startedAt }.
Adventure Hub: adv-daily-mission card with progress bar + Resume link appears when a quest is active; disappears after Abandon.
Quest abandon via Quest Board (quest-abandon-btn) clears questRun and removes daily mission card from /adventure.
/battle without activeRealmId still renders gracefully (default bg + 'Adventure: Meadowfall Path' title).
unverified_or_partial: battle-quest-complete-toast end-to-end (requires 3 deterministic correct answers in a row). Logic in gameStore.tickQuestOnCorrect was verified by code review (correctly awards XP/coins, clears questRun, returns completed:true with reward payload). UI wiring in Battle.tsx is verified (toast renders from questCompleteToast state, confetti fires, auto-dismiss after 4500ms). Recommend manual verification or exposing the store on window for deterministic E2E.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v0.7 critical flows are healthy. localStorage key is 'questing-academy-state-v1'; you can simulate quest near-completion by reading the JSON, setting state.questRun.progress = state.questRun.target - 1, writing it back, reloading, then answering a math question correctly. For K-grade addition/subtraction the prompt format is 'A + B' or 'A - B' so the correct answer is derivable from the prompt. NPC seed: only Linden (caretaker) and Bramble (teacher) are approved for realm-1; Mochi (shopkeeper) is 'pending' so its Talk icon is correctly hidden. To verify dialogue close in tests, prefer is_visible()==False (or wait_for_selector with state='hidden') over count()==0 because framer-motion AnimatePresence keeps the node in DOM during exit animation (~200-300ms).
rca of the issue: N/A — no product defects found. The lone test-script FAIL ('Dialogue closed via continue') was caused by Playwright querying count() during AnimatePresence's exit animation while the node was still mounted with opacity transitioning to 0. The dialogue is actually closed (screenshot confirms) and Bye/Continue handlers correctly call setDialogueNpc(null).
